criteria.criterion: The change writes down the cause of the empty `decisions` source in a committed file (CHANGELOG.md or docs/records.md), citing the code path (crates/athena-core/src/steward.rs and crates/athena-gate/src/records.rs) that produces the empty directory. A reader can check this with git diff.
criteria.evidence: Both CHANGELOG.md (Fixed entry) and the new docs/records.md section 'When the steward's `decisions` source is empty' give the cause: nothing is committed under the two paths at HEAD. They name `GitView::workspace` in crates/athena-core/src/steward.rs and `RecordSet::load` in crates/athena-gate/src/records.rs. I read both functions: RecordSet::load returns every blob under records/ at the tree (records.rs:27-55), and workspace writes them all and then creates any missing source dirs (steward.rs:258-277). The claim that D84 is text in docs/decisions.md is correct (docs/decisions.md:1846).

criteria.criterion: Either the diff changes crates/athena-core/src/steward.rs (or the record writer) so the steward's workspace holds decision records when they exist at HEAD, with a test in the same crate that builds a view containing a decision-state record and asserts the file appears under the decisions source paths, or the committed notes state why decisions cannot be read and what would change that.
criteria.evidence: The change takes the notes path. docs/records.md says decision-state records are written only when `watch_landing` sees a signal fire (watcher.rs:316-395, confirmed), and default-expectations records only by `record_default_expectations` (watcher.rs:400, confirmed). It ends with 'What would change this: a committed decision-state or default-expectations record.' The new test in steward.rs builds a GitView with a committed decision-state record and asserts the file appears in the workspace.

criteria.criterion: A test that the decisions source is populated when a decision-state record exists in the view and stays an empty directory when none exists; run `cargo test -p athena-core steward` and it passes.
criteria.evidence: 19 passed, 0 failed, including steward::tests::the_decisions_source_holds_decision_records_when_committed_and_is_an_empty_directory_when_not. findings.summary: The new comment and the docs say an empty decisions directory is 'never a copy fault'. That is too strong: if RecordSet::load fails, decisions is still left as an empty directory and is not reported unreadable.
findings.evidence: In the Err branch, `unreadable.extend(["jobs", "events", "introspections", "class-registry"])` leaves out "decisions". The create_dir_all loop then makes the decisions directories empty, so a load failure would look like an empty decisions source. This did not cause the reported case, because the other record sources were readable then. Adding "decisions" to that list would make the claim hold.

findings.summary: The notes do not say that `record_default_expectations` has no production caller. Nothing in production writes default-expectations records at all.
findings.evidence: Grep finds `record_default_expectations` called only in crates/athena-cli/tests/watcher.rs:118,124 and mentioned in docs. The notes say only that it is 'the only writer'. A reader would not learn that this half of the source can never fill in normal operation.

findings.summary: The test picks the decisions source by array position, `SOURCES[4]`, instead of by name.
findings.evidence: If SOURCES is reordered, the test would silently check another source. Looking the source up with `SOURCES.iter().find(|s| s.name == "decisions")` is sturdier.

findings.summary: The cause is deduced from the code, not confirmed against the real repository's records/ at HEAD.
findings.evidence: This snapshot has no records/, so I could not check that nothing is committed under records/decision-states. The deduction holds given the code: load copies every blob, and the other sources were readable. Treat it as code-derived.

summary: The change passes. It does what was asked by writing down the cause; the request allowed explaining why decisions cannot be read instead of making them readable. The cause it gives is that no decision-state or default-expectations record is committed at HEAD. The steward's workspace copies every committed record, so this is not a copy fault. D84 is design text in docs/decisions.md, not a record. I checked each claim against the code: RecordSet::load, GitView::workspace, the writers `watch_landing` and `record_default_expectations`, and D84 in docs/decisions.md. The cause is in CHANGELOG.md and docs/records.md, along with what would change it: a committed decision-state or default-expectations record. A new test shows the decisions source holds a committed decision-state record and stays an empty directory when none exists. It passes under `cargo test -p athena-core steward`. Athena's recorded fmt, clippy and full test runs passed. The change touches only 3 of the 5 expected files, so it stays in scope, and it edits nothing under records/ and no governance file. Two minor issues are worth fixing later. First, the "never a copy fault" claim overstates things: if RecordSet::load fails, the Err branch does not mark decisions unreadable. Second, the notes do not say that record_default_expectations has no production caller.
